policy.sourceReview: Cloned HEAD source/tests guide independently authored probes; execution uses corpus-pinned npm releases, not builds of these checkouts.
policy.reference: Chromium; failed references are invalid, not compatibility evidence.
policy.scope: Targeted initial audit; not full upstream suites or total feature coverage.
policy.plugins: Default core and explicit storage/geometry/css-typed-om configuration are separate.
policy.isolation: Fresh realm per probe, worker per engine; 90s engine deadline. Records the currently built runtime binding.
